⏸ plan mode on (shift+tab to cycle) · ? for shortcuts
Done. The export streams rows instead of buffering the whole table, so the 2M-row ledger no longer times out.
1. `exportCsv` writes through a `Transform` stream with a 4 KB buffer.
2. The integration test covers 250k rows and finishes in 1.8s.
3. PR #31 is open with the description from TASK.md.
